history.summary: RELATIONSHIP: this is a sub-shrine WITHIN the Bhabatarini Mandir complex at Kumarghat (seq 2348, id bhabatarini-mandir-kumarghat), kept as a separate record per the CSV row. The official Unakoti district website for Bhabatarini Mandir states the complex was founded in 1981 on Shivachaturdashi and includes 'a temple of god Shiva and an idol of Lord Buddha near the Bhabatarini Temple'; Shiva Chaturdashi draws thousands of devotees to the complex. No independent history, timings, or separate identity for the Shiva shrine are published - all details here describe the parent complex. POSSIBLE OVERLAP FLAG: seq 1049 (id shiva-temple-kumarghat) provisionally documented a generic 'Shiva Temple' POI in Kumarghat with different coordinates; not confirmed to be this shrine, treated separately. LOCATION FLAG: coordinates are the complex-level coordinates, not the shrine's exact position within it.

name: Shiva Temple, Bhabatarini Complex
town: Kumarghat (CSV town is correct; within the Bhabatarini Mandir complex)
town_description: Kumarghat is a town in Unakoti district, northern Tripura, about 26 km south of Kailashahar on the rail line to Agartala. It is a local commercial centre with several small temples, including the Bhabatarini complex and nearby Unakoti-region pilgrimage sites.

travel.airport: Maharaja Bir Bikram Airport, Agartala (~160 km by road)
travel.railway: Kumarghat Railway Station, within the town
travel.road: Within the Bhabatarini Mandir complex, Kumarghat town

visitor_information.best_time: Shiva Chaturdashi (Feb/March) is the peak period for this shrine
visitor_information.opening_hours: Not documented separately from the complex (verify locally)
